events.author: Alex
events.name: A Gesture of Good Faith

options.text: Your gesture is noted, and appreciated.

events.text: Greetings from [rival]. Though our banners now fly over lands we know lie close to your heart, we have chosen not to press our claim. Let it be known that we relinquish any right to that territory, offering this gesture in the spirit of goodwill and honorable conduct between our realms. May our dealings in the years ahead reflect the same fairness we show today.
